ocr.title: Invoice capture
ocr.description: Upload or photograph a document, edit every field, then explicitly confirm a draft expense or draft vendor bill only.

configurationState.disabled: State: Off - automatic reading is not enabled.
configurationState.fixture_only: State: Sample mode only - not live reading.
configurationState.configured_pending: State: Credentials pending - not live yet.
configurationState.live: State: Live - review and confirm before any draft.

ocr.providerNotConfigured: Automatic reading is off: no provider is connected. Amounts will not be invented from the document.
ocr.providerConfiguredStub: Automatic reading is not fully available yet. Amounts will not be invented from the document.
ocr.providerConfiguredPending: Credentials are present, but live analysis is not ready. This is not live reading. Amounts will not be invented from the document.
ocr.featureDisabled: Automatic document reading is off. You can add an expense manually. No live extraction runs.
ocr.providerLiveReady: Live reading is connected. Every field is a suggestion - review and confirm before creating a draft.
ocr.fixtureOnlyMode: Internal sample mode only - this is not live document reading.
ocr.honesty: Fields below are suggestions only. Everything is editable before confirm. No finalized financial transaction is created automatically.

inboxEmpty.processing: Nothing is being read right now.

ocr.extractQueuedReview: Review and confirm before creating a draft.
ocr.extractQueuedBackground: Reading in the background. You can keep working.
ocr.jobCancelled: Reading cancelled. No draft was created.
ocr.extractFailed: Could not read the document ({code}). No draft was created.
ocr.offlineBlocked: Document reading needs a connection. The file was not sent.
ocr.duplicateWarningTitle: Possible duplicate - review before creating a draft
ocr.duplicateOverrideHint: Confirm stays available. Check this only if you are sure this is a legitimate new document.
ocr.duplicateOverrideRequired: This looks like a duplicate. Check “This is not a duplicate” to create a draft anyway.
ocr.vendorNone: No matching supplier. Choose an existing one or add a supplier first.
ocr.warnTotalsMismatch: Net plus tax does not match the total. Check before confirming.
ocr.warnDiscountMismatch: Subtotal minus discount does not match the amount before VAT.
ocr.warnVatRateMismatch: VAT rate times taxable amount does not match the VAT amount.
ocr.warnAmountDueMismatch: Amount due differs from invoice total.
ocr.warnGrossMissing: Final total including VAT was not detected.
ocr.warnSupplierIdMissing: Supplier company / tax number was not detected.
ocr.warnPossibleWrongCustomer: This document may not be intended for this business.
ocr.warnLineSumMismatch: Line amounts do not match the document total.
ocr.warnDueBeforeIssue: Due date is before the document date.
ocr.warnVendorUnresolved: A supplier record is required for this draft.
ocr.multiVatRates: Multiple VAT rates detected on this document: {rates}. The primary VAT rate was left blank.
ocr.mappedOnly: Preview saved. No draft was created - confirm explicitly.
ocr.rejected: Review rejected. No draft was created.
ocr.notAllowed: You do not have permission for this action.
ocr.acceptRequired: Accept at least one field before creating a draft.
ocr.vendorRequired: Select a vendor before creating a draft vendor bill.
ocr.draftTargetHint: Draft only - never a finalized posting or recognized actual cost.
ocr.historyDescription: Accepted and rejected reviews. This is not the active work queue. Automatic reading may be off, credentials-pending, or live - see the queue banner.
ocr.sourceRetained: File details are kept. Confirm before creating a draft.
ocr.lineDescriptionsHint: Display only - copy into description if needed.
ocr.suggestionsHint: Labels only - not saved automatically. Confirm still creates a draft only.
ocr.suggestionNone: No project, purchase order, or subcontract suggestions for this supplier yet.

suggestionAgreementStrength.vendor_project_currency: Agreement on this project and currency

ocr.recommendationsHint: Choose a match to remember it for next time. This does not assign a project on an expense draft.
